'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female professor teaching about the Waveworn Phenomena, Void Storm. 

{{color|help|Players can attend Professor Cassini class at <nowiki>12:00-15:59</nowiki> in the Voidmatters Classroom.}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Cassini:''' The more frequent the Void Storm activity in an area, the greater the threat from Voidworms.
:'''Cassini:''' Such terrifying creatures... were once Exoswarm. But the Void Storm turned them into something else entirely. 

:'''Cassini:''' And this is exatly the pattern the Roya have recognized for generations.
:'''Cassini:''' If they see the Shimmer from a distant Void Storm, they immediately guide the Exoswarms to safety.
:'''Cassini:''' It's a pattern born from experience, and it's one we should be paying very close attention to.

:'''Cassini:''' Here in the Department of Voidmatters, our research on Waveworn Phenomena is about dissecting its true nature.
:'''Cassini:''' We've had a lot of transfer students coming in lately, recommended by the Black Shores. You should try interacting with them.
:'''Cassini:''' When it comes to Waveworn research, the Black Shores has tons of field experience.
:'''Cassini:''' If the right opportunity comes up and you seize it, landing an internship there isn't out of the question.
:'''Cassini:''' At the very least, you wouldn't have to worry about your graduation internship...

==Dialogue==
;Sit down
:'''Rover:''' I know this class...
:{{DIcon}} (Pay close attention.)
::'''Cassini:''' Here in the Department of Voidmatters, our research on {{Extra Effect|Waveworn Phenomena|Waveworn Phenomena|The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."}} is about dissecting its true nature.
::'''Cassini:''' We've had a lot of transfer students coming in lately, recommended by the Black Shores. You should try interacting with them.
::'''Cassini:''' When it comes to Waveworn research, the Black Shores has tons of field experience.
::'''Cassini:''' If the right opportunity comes up and you seize it, landing an internship there isn't out of the question.
::'''Cassini:''' At the very least, you wouldn't have to worry about your graduation internship...
::Time flies as the professors give their lecture. The bell rings before you even realize...
:{{DIcon}} (Doze off.)
{{Dialogue End}}
